done_when: At 768 pixels wide the board shows all five stages and the plan with no sideways scrolling of the page.
why: At half-screen width (768 pixels) the Forge board cannot be read: the five stage columns are too narrow, card titles are tiny, the plan is squeezed beside a fixed summary, the tasks table spills out of its box and loses its header, section and sub-section headings look the same, the "For the builders" line is small and grey, and three controls are under 24 pixels high.
